subject: Thanks for the call — next steps & VP/CTO intro
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the call — next steps & VP/CTO intro

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the candid discussion about Acme's inference goals and the latency/cost targets you're aiming for. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

- Recap: You need predictable latency for customer-facing features (~200ms 95th), multi-region failover, and a cost target that doesn't blow up at scale. We covered both Hosted and Dedicated options and how Dedicated reserved capacity can help your predictability goals.
- Next step 1 (technical deep dive/demo): schedule a 60-minute deep dive with our solutions engineering team to walk through a live demo, expected throughput, and KV/prefix caching patterns.
- Next step 2 (exec alignment): schedule a brief executive alignment call (VP / CTO) to unblock procurement and timeline decisions — I'd like to introduce Vivek Kulkarni (VP Sales) and our CTO/technical lead depending on availability.

Proposed times for the technical deep dive (PT):
- Thu Jun 3, 11:00–12:00
- Thu Jun 3, 14:00–15:00
- Fri Jun 4, 10:00–11:00

For the exec alignment (30 minutes) — a few windows we have:
- Wed Jun 9, 10:00–10:30
- Thu Jun 10, 11:00–11:30
- Fri Jun 11, 09:30–10:00

I've attached a short platform overview and a draft SOW so your procurement can start scoping. If you prefer, send over a few times that work for your CTO and VP and we'll coordinate on our side.

Proposed exec agenda (30m):
- 5m intros
- 10m business priorities & success metrics (Acme)
- 10m how Redwood maps to those (latency, cost, SLA)
- 5m next steps / procurement timeline

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood-Platform-Overview.pdf, SOW-draft-Acme-v1.docx

From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for the call — next steps & VP/CTO intro

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap.

Tom and I chatted briefly after the call. He can join the technical deep dive; our CTO, Aaron Patel, is the person we'd like on the exec alignment call (I copied our TA, Tom, here as well). A couple of notes:
- We do want to see the demo focus on 95th latency under concurrent user load and the KV caching examples you mentioned.
- Procurement wants a rough license/commit range in advance of the exec call so they can prep.

For availability:
- Technical deep dive: Thu Jun 3, 14:00–15:00 PT is best for our engineering team.
- Exec alignment: Wed Jun 9 at 10:00 PT works for Aaron and our VP of Product (they confirmed).

If you can confirm Vivek and whoever from the technical team will join, we'll lock both on our calendar.

Thanks,
Sarah Johnson
Director of Platform Engineering, Acme Corporation
sarah.johnson@acme.com
+1 (510) 555-0199

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply, Sarah. Glad Thu 3pm PT works for the deep dive. I've booked: Technical deep dive — Thu Jun 3, 14:00–15:00 PT (60m) — invite sent to Tom, Rishi, and our SE lead.

For the exec alignment on Wed Jun 9 at 10:00 PT, I've looped in Vivek (VP Sales) and Rishi (SE) to join the call. Vivek — Sarah has confirmed Aaron Patel (CTO) and their VP of Product for Jun 9 at 10:00 PT. Can you please confirm your availability? If you're not available, let me know an alternate and we'll propose a swap.

Draft agenda for the exec call (so everyone is aligned):
- 1–2 min intros
- 8–10 min Acme priorities & success metrics
- 10–12 min Redwood proposal: deployment modes, cost profile, SLA and timeline to production
- 5 min procurement/next steps and proposed timeline (SOW / PO / procurement path)

I've re-attached the SOW draft for procurement to review ahead of the call.

Thanks all — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole

Vivek
